record.title: Evaluate the handoff controls and gate the waiting stock region
record.intent: Release the stock test only after a complete private pass or admit a bounded successor for the observed failure.
requirements: Evaluate raw private evidence and separate confirmed guest behavior from reference-kernel explanations and synthetic instrument values.
Require a complete private pass and identical executable before the waiting stock-init-tail task; negative results keep stock gated.
Commit a precise gate record or explicit bounded successor while retaining static-first subsystem recovery and selective runtime falsification.
acceptance: Commit and push the decision before successor execution.
